open_limitations: Constructed example; encoding diagnosis requires source metadata
Regex behavior depends on the stated engine and character policy
CSV dialect and missing-value rules must come from the provider
Whitespace tokens are not universal words; corpus is synthetic
Displayed catalog records come from a dated fixture; service behavior can change
Synthetic archived page tests selectors and cannot establish live-site coverage
OCR accuracy is measured on one clear synthetic image; native engines can differ
Reference labels encode one fictional codebook application and are not ground truth
Small keyword-model scores are not calibrated and have no external validity
Package fixtures demonstrate schemas and are not authenticated source subsets
Eleven fictional items cannot estimate reviewer reliability
Synthetic templates add no labor-market observations and still require human review
Rules were designed in-sample and challenge cases are not independent evaluation
